notes: The maintainers' fix for an order dependent test: assertEquals(allFieldsInteger, FieldUtils.getAllFieldsList(Integer.class)), two List<Field> values, becomes assertEquals(new HashSet(allFieldsInteger), new HashSet(FieldUtils.getAllFieldsList(Integer.class))), because getDeclaredFields() returns fields in no particular order. Converting both sides to a set drops the order and also the count of duplicates, and neither side is declared as a Set, so the named weakening equality_relaxed applies. Policy reject: a class cannot declare a field twice, so for this test the set comparison loses nothing, but no diff rule can know that; sorting both sides with full equality, as the later fix in accept-id-sort-both-sides-full-equality does, is the form the rules accept. The whole commit is kept: it changes only this file. The commit message names LANG-1514.
